title: Solace
hook: A quiet place to keep thoughts and feelings — and tend to them like a garden.
text: Solace is a safe place to store your thoughts and feelings. It is a fun way to do some gardening — planting what you feel, and watching what grows.
highlights: A safe place to store thoughts and feelings.
The gardening metaphor drives the whole interaction.
Full-stack build, from the data model to the interface.

caseStudy.problem: Journalling tools tend to feel clinical. I wanted somewhere private that felt alive enough to return to.
caseStudy.approach: I built Solace around a gardening metaphor: thoughts are planted, kept and revisited rather than filed away in a list.
caseStudy.learned: A strong metaphor is an architecture decision. It changes what the interface asks of you, not just how it looks.
